speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned waking up frightened; can you tell me if you dream about specific scary events or if you just wake up with no memory of a dream? Also, do you feel like someone or something is standing over your bed?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Nocturnal Panic Attacks (or Sleep Terrors) secondary to significant sleep deprivation or acute stress; please consider a sleep study to rule out obstructive sleep apnea and review recent environmental stressors.
